Sub: Intimation for Earnings Call 
 
Dear Sir(s), 
 
This is in continuation of our earlier intimation dated October 26, 2026, regarding the Earnings Call 
scheduled on November 05, 2026, to discuss the operational and financial performance for Q2 & 
H1FY27. In this regard, we wish to inform you that, the Earnings Call, which was originally scheduled 
to be held on Thursday, 05th November 2026 at 04:00 P.M. (IST) has been rescheduled and will now 
be held at 03:30 P.M. (IST) on the same date.  
 
All other details of the Earnings Call, as communicated earlier, shall remain unchanged.  
 
This is for your information and records please. 
 
Thanking you. 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For Uno Minda Limited
